Blended Program: 138 units Students in the blended Bachelor of Science in Economics - Quantitative Economics Subplan/Option and Master of Science in Quantitative Economics program will complete the requirements for both the BS and MS degrees. Economics, B.S. - Quantitative Economics Subplan/Option: 120 units Quantitative Economics, M.S.: 30 units Double-Counting of Courses Students in the blended program may double-count the following four courses (12 units) towards their BS and MS degrees: EC 4403 EC 4406 EC 4444 EC 4XXX or EC 5XXX (3 units required excluding EC 4000 and EC 4620W ) These courses cannot be substituted with other courses; no exceptions Add to My Favorites (opens a new window) Share this Page Facebook this Page (opens a new window) Tweet this Page (opens a new window) Print (opens a new window) Help (opens a new window) T Apply Maps Visit Contact Us Copyright ©2025 California State Polytechnic University, Pomona.
